services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    container_name: postgres_dashapp_container
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE:-yii2_db}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER:-yii2_user}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-userpassword}
      INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-einfallsreich}
      ADMIN_EMAIL: ${ADMIN_EMAIL:-}
    volumes:
      - db_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./sql/base_model.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/00-base_model.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 10s
    networks:
      - backend_network

  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.6
    container_name: traefik_proxy_container
    restart: always
    command:
      - "--providers.docker=true"
      - "--providers.docker.exposedbydefault=false"
      - "--providers.docker.network=backend_network"
      - "--entrypoints.web.address=:80"
      - "--entrypoints.websecure.address=:443"
      - "--certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.email=${LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL}"
      - "--certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.storage=/letsencrypt/acme.json"
      - "--certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.httpchallenge=true"
      - "--certificatesresolvers.letsencrypt.acme.httpchallenge.entrypoint=web"
      - "--log.level=${TRAEFIK_LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}"
    ports:
      - "${TRAEFIK_HTTP_PORT:-80}:80"
      - "${TRAEFIK_HTTPS_PORT:-443}:443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - letsencrypt_data:/letsencrypt
    networks:
      - backend_network

  web:
    image: ${WEB_IMAGE:-registry.opencode.de/sh/digitalhub-sh/landesprogramm-offene-innovationen/kommunalenergie/gitlab-profile:latest}
    container_name: yii2_vue_dash_container
    restart: always
    expose:
      - "80"
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=postgres
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_DATABASE=${DB_DATABASE:-yii2_db}
      - DB_USER=${DB_USER:-yii2_user}
      - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-userpassword}
      - SENTRY_DSN
      - SENTRY_BACKEND_DSN
      - SENTRY_FRONTEND_DSN
      - VITE_APP_TITLE
      - VITE_APP_SUBTITLE_FRONTEND
      - VITE_APP_SUBTITLE_BACKEND
      - VITE_FOOTER_TEXT
      - VITE_FOOTER_LINK
      - APP_FRONTEND_NAME
      - APP_BACKEND_NAME
      - APP_BACKEND_HOME_URL
      - APP_BACKEND_BASE_URL
      - APP_FRONTEND_SESSION_NAME
      - APP_BACKEND_SESSION_NAME
      - FRONTEND_COOKIE_VALIDATION_KEY
      - BACKEND_COOKIE_VALIDATION_KEY
      - API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY:?Set API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY to 32 random base64-encoded bytes}
      - SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=${SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD:?Set SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD}
      - ENABLE_CSRF_VALIDATION_FRONTEND
      - ENABLE_CSRF_VALIDATION_BACKEND
      - ADMIN_EMAIL
      - SUPPORT_EMAIL
      - SENDER_EMAIL
      - SENDER_NAME
      - PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE
      - MAILER_SCHEME
      - MAILER_HOST
      - MAILER_USER
      - MAILER_PASSWORD
      - MAILER_PORT
      - MAILER_USE_FILE_TRANSPORT
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.docker.network=backend_network"
      - "traefik.http.services.yii.loadbalancer.server.port=80"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-http.rule=Host(`${APP_DOMAIN}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-http.entrypoints=web"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-http.middlewares=${TRAEFIK_HTTP_ROUTER_MIDDLEWARES-yii-https-redirect}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-http.service=yii"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.rule=Host(`${APP_DOMAIN}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.entrypoints=websecure"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.tls=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.tls.certresolver=${TRAEFIK_TLS_CERTRESOLVER-letsencrypt}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.middlewares=yii-https-proxy-headers"
      - "traefik.http.routers.yii-https.service=yii"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-https-redirect.redirectscheme.scheme=https"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-https-redirect.redirectscheme.port=${TRAEFIK_HTTPS_PORT-443}"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-https-redirect.redirectscheme.permanent=true"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-noop.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Proto=http"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-noop.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Port=80"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-https-proxy-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Proto=https"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.yii-https-proxy-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Port=443"
    networks:
      - backend_network
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - yii2-uploaded-files:/app/htdocs/uploads
      - yii2-system-assets:/app/runtime/system-assets

  iothubsh-adapter:
    image: ${IOTHUBSH_ADAPTER_IMAGE:-registry.opencode.de/sh/digitalhub-sh/landesprogramm-offene-innovationen/kommunalenergie/gitlab-profile/iothubsh-adapter:latest}
    container_name: iothubsh_adapter
    restart: always
    expose:
      - "8000"
    environment:
      - APP_DOMAIN
      - IOTHUBSH_CONFIG_PATH=/data/config.json
      - IOTHUBSH_NODE_NAME=iothubsh FastAPI Adapter
      - IOTHUBSH_REQUEST_TIMEOUT=10
      - IOTHUBSH_TARGET_BASE_URL=${IOTHUBSH_TARGET_BASE_URL:-http://web}
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.docker.network=backend_network"
      - "traefik.http.services.iothubsh-adapter.loadbalancer.server.port=8000"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-http.rule=(Host(`${APP_DOMAIN}`) || Host(`192.168.10.205`)) && (Path(`/webhook/config`) || Path(`/webhook/measurement`))"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-http.entrypoints=web"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-http.priority=100"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-http.middlewares=${TRAEFIK_HTTP_ROUTER_MIDDLEWARES-iothubsh-adapter-https-redirect}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-http.service=iothubsh-adapter"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.rule=(Host(`${APP_DOMAIN}`) || Host(`192.168.10.205`)) && (Path(`/webhook/config`) || Path(`/webhook/measurement`))"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.entrypoints=websecure"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.priority=100"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.tls=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.tls.certresolver=${TRAEFIK_TLS_CERTRESOLVER-letsencrypt}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.middlewares=iothubsh-adapter-https-proxy-headers"
      - "traefik.http.routers.iothubsh-adapter-https.service=iothubsh-adapter"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-https-redirect.redirectscheme.scheme=https"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-https-redirect.redirectscheme.port=${TRAEFIK_HTTPS_PORT-443}"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-https-redirect.redirectscheme.permanent=true"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-noop.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Proto=http"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-noop.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Port=80"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-https-proxy-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Proto=https"
      - "traefik.http.middlewares.iothubsh-adapter-https-proxy-headers.headers.customrequestheaders.X-Forwarded-Port=443"
    networks:
      - backend_network
    depends_on:
      - web
    volumes:
      - iothubsh-adapter-data:/data
networks:
  backend_network:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  db_data:
  yii2-uploaded-files:
  yii2-system-assets:
  letsencrypt_data:
  iothubsh-adapter-data:
